programme.title: Dance Moms
programme.sub-title: Abby's Dance-a-Thon: The Worst to the Best Dances
programme.desc: (PG) When the dance moms get in Abby's way, things often go awry; when out of her way, her young dancers bring home gold. In this episode watch Abby tackle the mama drama.

programme.title: Dance Moms
programme.sub-title: How Do You Like Them Apples?
programme.desc: Young dancers train and compete under a demanding coach while striving for success in elite competitions.
